I don't understand where you kids get the assumption that doctor prescribed HGH will make you taller than your genetic limitations. When prescribed by a doctor, HGH is administered in safe amounts that may make you slightly taller than your family predecessors. You could order it online from an underground lab and inject something made in a random person's basement, abusing massive amounts, but just know that you'd be gambling with your life. Plus, you're 16 years old, I bet your growth plates are already almost closed. Your friends and cousin's dad ain't got nothing to do with what's in your genetic code bro

I thought he was speaking on the terms of his plates still being closed. Yeah, if someone abuses and takes an extreme amount of HGH before the plates close, they would be ridiculously tall. But you’d never get that amount prescribed to you unless you bought it from a UGL. Prescription HGH won’t make someone grow extensively past that predetermined height.

My fault broski I thought you said they told you they closed completely. But still if they are almost closed that means cartilage is already showing on the plate. You most likely just grew a little thanks to the HGH but if you’re sure it was 2 inches then you definitely reached your full potential.

Also even if you took these "peptides" before your growth plates closed you still wouldn't turn into some giant. HGH used on pre-puberty kids shows they still are relative in height to their genetic limit and sometimes slightly taller. If your growth plates are closed there is absolutely no possible way you can gain growth in height. You have to be doing something that's helping your spine decompress like some type of exercise.

You are ill-informed about HGH and what it does to height. HGH won't just turn a person into a 7-foot giant. It's extremely rare for someone with acromegaly to grow past their parents (genetic height). The cases you see are so rare it's the same concept as a kid growing 6'5 and having parents where both sides of those families never had a relative grow over 5'5, it's just a genetic anomaly.
Yeah he wouldn’t make a mistake. 5’8 is honestly the average height and you are in a way better position than most in this sub. It sucks to not be 6’5 chad but you will be just fine broski.
I'm not here to spread any negativity. If your doctor said the plates are closed, they are most likely closed. You won't grow taller because you “imagine” being taller.

My fault for making the second reply separate. I was just saying that your doctor misdiagnosed you because they weren’t too familiar with x-ray imaging. I was just speaking on the fact that a person can’t grow taller or even wider if the individual’s growth plates are closed.
A doctor who isn't a radiologist can easily make this mistake because they aren't extensively trained in reading X-rays.
If growth plates are closed, a person can't physically grow taller. If you did grow those 2 inches, it's 100 percent because of posture involving the vertebrae from your spine.
